test_cases.test_case_description: Verify the screen when the user enables only the 'Email' destination in the 'Add Shortcut' screen.

steps.description: Install and Launch the HPX app.
steps.expected: User should be navigated to the 'Add Email' screen.

steps.description: Click on the printer icon on the root view screen.
Then click on the shortcuts tile on the device details page.
Click on the Add new shortcuts in shortcuts screen.
Then click on the Create your own shortcut arrow button.
Enable only the 'Email' destination toggle bar in 'Add Shortcut' screen.
Then click on the Continue button.
